result:
**Short answer:** In O3, the *active* visit is the patient's open visit, and the *current* visit is the visit the chart is working in. The current visit is normally the active one, but a user can pick a past (retrospective) visit to work in instead. The definitions are in the JSDoc on `useVisit` in `openmrs-esm-core`. The O3 docs only use the terms and do not define them.

**Definitions (documented in code)**
- `useVisit` JSDoc says there are "potentially two relevant visits": the **active** visit is "the most recent visit without an end date", and the **current** visit "is the active visit, unless a retrospective visit has been selected." If neither exists there is no current visit. If only a retrospective visit exists, that one is current, and `currentVisitIsRetrospective` says so. (openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:32-47)
- The return type marks `currentVisit` and `currentVisitIsRetrospective` as `@deprecated`: "current visit" is "not well defined outside of the patient chart", and code should use `visitContext` there. (openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:18-28)

**Implementation**
- `activeVisit` is the result with `stopDatetime === null` from a fetch with `includeInactive=false`. (openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:66, 87-90)
- `currentVisit` is only set when a retrospective visit UUID is stored for this patient. Otherwise it is `null`. (openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:65, 92-95)
- An effect makes the active visit the chart's context when no visit was chosen manually. It clears the context when the current visit gets ended. (openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useVisit.ts:98-117)
- In the chart, the working visit is `visitContext` in the patient chart store. Its docs say workspaces should receive the visit as a prop rather than read it from the store. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/store/patient-chart-store.ts:3-15)
- `patient-chart.resources.ts` uses the stored `visitContext` when it matches the patient. Otherwise it falls back to `useVisit`'s `activeVisit`. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:84-94)

**How the two are used**
- The banner "Active Visit" tag shows `activeVisit`, and hides when the stored context is a past visit. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx:13-21)
- The banner "past visit" tag shows when the stored context has ended. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/past-visit-tag.extension.tsx:15-18)
- The end-visit dialog ends `activeVisit`, then clears the context if it was the one in use. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx:22-38)
- Vitals treats the context as active when it has no `stopDatetime`. (openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-and-biometrics-header/vitals-header.extension.tsx:50)

**O3 docs (usage only)**
- Workspaces that need an active visit use `useLaunchWorkspaceRequiringVisit`, and O3 prompts for a visit if there is none. (openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/workspaces/launching-workspaces.mdx:39, 57)
- The encounter tile requires an active visit by default, and `showWhenExpression` is evaluated against the current visit's attributes. (openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/configure-o3/configure-the-patient-chart.mdx:142, 256)

**Discrepancy:** The `useVisit` JSDoc says the current visit is the active visit by default. The hook's own `currentVisit` field is `null` in that case, and only the store's `visitContext` gets the active visit (via the effect above). Callers that read `currentVisit` directly will see `null` when the user has not chosen a past visit.
